Version 0.4.0

- Added OpenClaw plugin manifest (openclaw.plugin.json) and new entry point (src/openclaw-entry.ts) for deeper OpenClaw integration.
- Updated dependencies in package.json and package-lock.json.
- Modified tests/clawhub-publishing.test.ts to support new plugin features.

- Introduced new command listener and Firebase client modules for improved notification handling.
- Added tests for command listener and Firebase client functionality.
- Refactored core logic for better modularity in `src/index.ts` and related files.
- Updated types and enhanced code structure for maintainability.

- BREAKING: MetricEntry and AuditEntry types were renamed to MetricItem and AuditFinding, with corresponding property changes.
- Updated send_hashbox_notification API: payload parameter now accepts updated MetricItem[] and AuditFinding[] shapes.
- Documentation and usage examples refreshed in SKILL.md to reflect the new data types and payload structure.
- Package updated to version 0.2.0.

Initial release of hashbox-plugin.

- Integrates OpenClaw AI agents with the HashBox iOS app via Firebase webhook for push notifications.
- Provides tools to configure the API connection (`configure_hashbox`) using an `HB-` token.
- Supports sending three notification payload types (`article`, `metric`, and `audit`) with custom channels and content.
- Local configuration storage in `hashbox_config.json`.
- Detailed setup instructions and example usage included.
